# Comprehensive Requirements Quality Checklist: Multi-Jurisdiction Filter

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and constitutional compliance of the multi-jurisdiction filter specification before proceeding to implementation planning  
**Created**: 2025-07-17  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)  
**Depth**: Formal governance review  
**Audience**: Author + peer reviewer (pre-plan gate)  
**Focus Areas**: Constitutional compliance, frontend UX requirements, backend/API requirements, cross-cutting consistency  

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Items test the **quality of the requirements themselves** — not whether an implementation works correctly.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 — Are loading state requirements specified independently for each catalog section (Organisation Catalog, Framework Catalog, and Rehearsal Replay), or only generically? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK002 — Are empty state requirements defined separately for "no jurisdictions selected" versus "jurisdictions selected but no matching data exists"? The spec currently addresses only the former. [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Edge Case §2]
- [ ] CHK003 — Are stale-response cancellation requirements specified with sufficient detail (e.g., request sequencing or abort semantics) beyond "discarded if a newer request has been issued"? [Completeness, Edge Case §3]
- [ ] CHK004 — Are requirements defined for the initial page-load sequence when URL contains jurisdiction parameters — specifically the order of jurisdiction list fetch → URL parse → validation → catalog data fetch? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 — Is tenant_id propagation required for the jurisdiction list endpoint itself (FR-007), or only for organisation/framework queries (FR-005)? The spec is explicit only for FR-005. [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 — Are requirements defined for how "Select All" and "Clear All" controls interact with the 300ms debounce? Does "Select All" trigger a single debounced call or nine sequential toggle events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §NFR-002, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 — Are error handling requirements specified for the jurisdiction list endpoint failure (FR-007)? FR-012 covers catalog failures but not the control's data source. [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-012, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 — Are data deduplication requirements in FR-009 specified for all entity types that may span jurisdictions, or only organisations? Do frameworks via FrameworkAssignment also require deduplication? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 — Is "within 2 seconds" in SC-001 measured from the end of the 300ms debounce window, from the user's last interaction, or from the API request dispatch? The timing budget is ambiguous given the debounce delay. [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, §NFR-002]
- [ ] CHK010 — Is "inline error message" in FR-012 sufficiently specified — what content, placement within the catalog section, and retry interaction pattern? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 — Is the relationship "associated with" for organisations (FR-002) defined with a concrete data model path, or is it assumed to be the jurisdiction identifier list on the Organisation entity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK012 — Is "user-friendly message" for the disabled replay button (FR-011) specified with content guidelines, or left to implementation discretion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK013 — Is "appropriate empty state" for jurisdictions with no data (Edge Case §2) differentiated from the "no jurisdictions selected" empty state (FR-006)? [Clarity, Edge Case §2, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 — Is the "notice" in FR-015 (stale replay warning) specified with content, prominence, and dismissal behaviour? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK015 — Are the "full human-readable name" display requirements (FR-008) specified for localisation, abbreviation contexts (e.g., mobile viewport), or only a single canonical form? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Constitutional Compliance

### Human-in-the-Loop (Constitution §1)

- [ ] CHK016 — Does running a cross-jurisdictional rehearsal replay constitute an "irreversible real-world action" requiring explicit human confirmation beyond the button click? Are the boundaries of this gate defined for the replay feature? [Constitution §1, Spec §FR-004, Gap]

### Data Sovereignty (Constitution §2)

- [ ] CHK017 — Does the spec confirm that all jurisdiction data queries (including the new multi-jurisdiction endpoints) route through Azure Australia East / Australia Southeast regions? [Constitution §2, Spec §FR-005, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 — Are requirements defined to prevent jurisdiction or organisation data from being cached in client-side storage mechanisms that could replicate data outside sovereign boundaries? [Constitution §2, Gap]

### Privacy (Constitution §3)

- [ ] CHK019 — Could the combination of selected jurisdictions constitute user behavioural profiling data under the Privacy Act 1988? Are privacy requirements specified for jurisdiction selection telemetry or analytics? [Constitution §3, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 — Are requirements defined for whether jurisdiction selection history is logged, and if so, what retention and access controls apply? [Constitution §3, §IV, Gap]

### Interoperability (Constitution §4)

- [ ] CHK021 — Do the new multi-jurisdiction API endpoints expose standards-based interfaces (OpenAPI documentation) as required by the constitution's interoperability principle? [Constitution §4, Spec §FR-005, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 — Are the multi-jurisdiction query parameter formats (e.g., comma-separated vs repeated params) specified in a way that aligns with existing platform API conventions? [Interoperability, Spec §FR-005, Gap]

### Graceful Degradation (Constitution §5)

- [ ] CHK023 — Is fallback behaviour specified when the jurisdiction list endpoint itself is unavailable? Can the page function at all without the jurisdiction list? [Constitution §5, Spec §FR-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 — Are partial failure requirements complete — specifically, what happens when one catalog's API succeeds but another fails in the same jurisdiction query? [Constitution §5, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK025 — Is degradation behaviour defined for when Entra ID claims (tenant_id) are unavailable or the auth token is expired mid-session? [Constitution §5, Spec §FR-005, Gap]

### Azure-Native (Constitution §VIII)

- [ ] CHK026 — Does the spec confirm Azure-native service usage for any new caching, queuing, or search infrastructure required by multi-jurisdiction filtering? [Constitution §VIII, Gap]

### Auditability (Constitution §IV)

- [ ] CHK027 — Are audit logging requirements defined for jurisdiction selection changes, given the constitution mandates full provenance for all agent actions? [Constitution §IV, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 — Does "silently ignore invalid identifiers" in FR-014 conflict with the constitution's auditability requirement? Should invalid URL parameters be logged even if ignored in the UI? [Conflict, Spec §FR-014, Constitution §IV]

### PPRR Lifecycle Alignment

- [ ] CHK029 — Does the spec explicitly document how multi-jurisdiction filtering supports the Preparedness phase of the PPRR lifecycle, and whether it has implications for other phases (Response, Recovery)? [Constitution PPRR, Gap]

### WCAG Accessibility (NFR-001)

- [ ] CHK030 — Are WCAG requirements specified beyond keyboard navigation — including colour contrast ratios for selected/unselected states, visible focus indicators, and touch target sizes? [Accessibility, Spec §NFR-001, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 — Are screen reader announcement requirements defined for dynamic catalog content updates after jurisdiction selection changes (ARIA live regions)? [Accessibility, Spec §NFR-001, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 — Are focus management requirements specified for after error display, retry action, and loading-to-loaded transitions in catalog sections? [Accessibility, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK033 — Do FR-006 (empty state prompt) and FR-011 (disabled replay message) use consistent language and UX patterns for the same "no jurisdictions selected" condition? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK034 — Is FR-014's URL persistence behaviour fully consistent with spec 020's URL-driven filter pattern as claimed? Are any differences or extensions documented? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec 020]
- [ ] CHK035 — Do FR-002 ("associated with") and FR-003 ("linked via FrameworkAssignment") use consistent terminology for what is fundamentally the same filtering concept across different entity types? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK036 — Are the debounce timing requirements in NFR-002 and Edge Case §3 stated identically (both 300ms), without any conflicting or additive timing specifications? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-002, Edge Case §3]
- [ ] CHK037 — Is the "clear previous results immediately" requirement in FR-013 (loading states) consistent with FR-015's "clear replay results" behaviour, or do they imply different clearing mechanisms? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK038 — Are the "no stale data" requirements applied uniformly across FR-012 (error states), FR-013 (loading states), and FR-015 (replay jurisdiction mismatch)? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK039 — Is SC-001's "within 2 seconds" total budget explicitly decomposed across debounce (300ms) + API round-trip + client rendering, so each segment can be independently measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK040 — Is SC-005's "50% reduction in interactions" baseline defined? What constitutes the current single-jurisdiction workflow interaction count? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK041 — Is SC-006's "90% of first-time users" measurable with a defined measurement method (user testing, analytics, heuristic evaluation)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK042 — Does SC-003 ("accurately reflect the selected jurisdictions") define what "accurately" means in measurable terms for cross-jurisdictional replay findings? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK043 — Are requirements defined for partial API failure — specifically when one catalog endpoint succeeds and another fails for the same jurisdiction set? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK044 — Are requirements specified for browser back/forward navigation when URL-persisted jurisdiction state changes? Does the browser history entry model match user expectations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Gap]
- [ ] CHK045 — Are migration or transition requirements defined for moving from the legacy hardcoded NSW behaviour to the new multi-jurisdiction empty-state default? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK046 — Are requirements defined for what happens when a previously-valid jurisdiction is deactivated or removed from the seed data while a user has it selected or bookmarked? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK047 — Are requirements specified for concurrent jurisdiction changes arriving while a previous debounced API call is still in-flight? Does the spec fully address the race condition beyond "discard stale responses"? [Coverage, Edge Case §3]
- [ ] CHK048 — Are acceptance scenarios for User Story 1 sufficient to cover Commonwealth-only selection (without any state/territory)? Scenario §3 always pairs Commonwealth with states. [Coverage, Spec US-1]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK049 — Is the "all nine jurisdictions selected" performance scenario (Edge Case §1) quantified with expected data volumes and explicit response time targets, or only described qualitatively as "no performance degradation"? [Edge Case §1, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK050 — Is URL length addressed when all nine jurisdiction identifiers are encoded in query parameters? Could this exceed browser URL limits with additional page state? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014, Gap]
- [ ] CHK051 — Are requirements defined for concurrent browser tabs or windows sharing the same session but with different jurisdiction selections? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK052 — Are requirements specified for handling a jurisdiction list API response that returns fewer than nine or more than nine jurisdictions (future additions / data integrity issues)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK053 — Is the dependency on spec 018's FrameworkAssignment data model validated as currently implemented and stable, or is it a forward-looking assumption? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK054 — Is the dependency on spec 020's URL-driven filter pattern documented with specific integration points and any required adaptations for multi-value jurisdiction parameters? [Dependency, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK055 — Is the dependency on specs 007/021 for tenant_id derivation from Entra ID claims validated against the current authentication implementation? [Dependency, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK056 — Is the assumption of "40–60 organisations" (Assumptions §5) validated against current seed data, and is a threshold defined for when pagination or lazy loading becomes required? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK057 — Is the assumption that OR-logic filtering (union of jurisdictions) is the only required mode validated? Are there scenarios where AND-logic (intersection) would be needed? [Assumption]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK058 — Is the sort order of combined multi-jurisdiction results specified? When organisations from NSW and VIC are merged, what determines display order? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK059 — Does "silently ignore invalid identifiers" (FR-014) conflict with the constitution's auditability requirement (§IV) that mandates logging of all actions? Should invalid parameters be logged server-side even if silently handled client-side? [Conflict, Spec §FR-014, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK060 — Is the "no stale data" principle achievable without race conditions during rapid jurisdiction toggling within the debounce window? Are the concurrency semantics (last-write-wins, request cancellation) precisely defined? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013, §NFR-002]
- [ ] CHK061 — Is there a requirement ID or acceptance criteria ID scheme established for this spec? FR-001 through FR-015 exist but acceptance scenarios in user stories lack IDs, reducing traceability. [Traceability, Gap]
